baseline: One classification from exact prepared task.
harness: Same exact prepared task for initial classification; then one review using original task plus initial output as data: check whether label reflects amusement rather than merely joke intent or offensiveness, preserve uncertainty, return only same strict JSON schema. No new text generation or external facts.
controls: Same model/settings, fresh sessions, randomized arm order, no best-of cherry-picking; record both calls for harness and one baseline; human gold never visible.
